descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Flight Simulator Glasgow puts you in the captain's seat over the real west of Scotland.

THE REAL GLASGOW
Real satellite, elevation and map data: the City Chambers, the Cathedral and the Necropolis, the Armadillo, the Hydro, the Glasgow Tower, the Finnieston Crane, the Riverside Museum, Kelvingrove, the University, Celtic Park, Ibrox and Hampden.

THE CLYDE, LOCH LOMOND AND STIRLING
Down the river past Clydebank's Titan crane, Dumbarton Rock and Greenock to the Firth. North to Loch Lomond's islands, the Campsies, Stirling Castle, the Wallace Monument, the Kelpies and the Falkirk Wheel.

FLY UNDER THE ERSKINE BRIDGE
Low down the Clyde and under the bridge's deck, 45 metres above the water.

A LIVING CITY
Trains on their real tracks, CalMac ferries on the Firth, Whitelee's turbines turning. At night the Hydro, the bridges and the stadiums light up.

AIR TRAFFIC CONTROL
Taxi and takeoff clearances and your landing clearance.

YOUR GLASS HANGAR
Every flight starts in your glass hangar on Pacific Quay, the Glasgow Tower out of the doors. Walk around, repaint, wash, fly.

FOUR AIRCRAFT
Two private jets with walk-through cabins, a midsize jet and a fighter.

ELEVEN MISSIONS
City approach, Ayrshire coast approach, Prestwick hop, down the Clyde, under the Erskine Bridge, Loch Lomond and Stirling, a scramble, Glasgow by night, a city tour.

FLY TOGETHER ONLINE
Quick Match or a private sky with a code. Voice chat stays off until you turn it on.
